children: Japanese stocks might rise on their first day of trading this week. Nikkei futures open at 65915 on the SGX, down 835 points from Wednesday but up 755 points from Friday. Japanese markets were closed Monday through Wednesday for national holidays. The dollar is at 158.35 yen, compared with Y157.12 as of Friday's Tokyo stock market close. Investors are focusing on the U.S.-China summit, crude oil prices and bond yields. The Nikkei Stock Average rose 1.4% to 65018.95 on Friday. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
